name: standby-lhs
summary: EXPERIMENTAL: link-held standby - when the source keeps the DP link up without video, stay dark (panel+backlight off, standby LED) instead of looping through 'No signal'; wake on valid timing or key; deep standby as soon as the source releases the link
status: analysis + assembler-verified, hardware test required. Use INSTEAD of panel-seq (includes it)

edits.asm: code cave in linker padding 0x203800-0x203FFF (see notes)
b.jal 0x24578b -> b.jal 0x245860 (pre-standby: guarded one-shot panel off (was sub_24578B))
b.j 0x245860 -> b.j 0x203800 (refusal tail: set pre-standby flag, then panel off)
b.jal 0x2457fb -> b.jal 0x203889 (cancel pre-standby by key (was sub_2457FB); power key skips the panel-on)
b.jal 0x2457fb -> b.jal 0x203851 (cancel pre-standby in sub_266B56 (was sub_2457FB))

notes: Refusal (standby_gate_query says the source still holds the link) now re-enters the existing pre-standby state (flg 0x4551AE bit4: panel/backlight off via the guarded panel-off, red LED, countdown idle) instead of returning to 'No signal'. While refused (rws 0x4551CC != 0), sub_263995 no longer arms the signal re-evaluation (0x4551B5) on DP link events, which is what restarted the No-signal state, the 255 s countdown and the white LED. The vendor's 5-tick gate re-query (sub_261C04 @0x261DE4) is unchanged, so deep power-save is entered as soon as the source releases the link. Exits: valid timing (vendor relight in sub_23ADAF, which for rws!=0 already requires a valid signal) clears the pre-standby flag and arms one re-evaluation so the OSD state returns to normal; a key/event that cancels pre-standby clears rws and uses the full panel-on (eDP enable + link training). Stock behaviour is kept for normal pre-standby (rws=0): relight requests there stay no-ops as before. The power key (code 0x2A) cancels pre-standby without the panel-on, so switching off from standby no longer lights the panel briefly. Code cave: 159 bytes at 0x203800 in the 2 KB zero padding before .text (0x204000); nothing references 0x203800-0x203FFF. Source: tools/patches_src_standby_lhs.py (aeonasm).
